how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-barrens-04-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:879:progress:0: How goes your hunt, ⟦13⟧? ⟦14⟧⟦15⟧⟦16⟧⟦E24⟧ thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, ⟦17⟧ but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.⟦18⟧⟦19⟧My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so ⟦E22⟧ regrets nothing. ⟦20⟧

rows.quest:885:details:0: The feather of ⟦E27⟧ is painful to the touch.
rows.quest:885:progress:0: There is new resolve within you, ⟦25⟧. A resolve born from pain...⟦26⟧⟦27⟧Are you burdened with the death of ⟦E27⟧?

rows.quest:885:completion:2: The pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs. The sting you felt is the pain of regret.
rows.quest:885:completion:3: But I can see you have conquered this. You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength.
rows.quest:906:obj:0: Bring ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E24⟧ at the Crossroads in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:906:details:0: Take Lok's head to ⟦E24⟧ in the Crossroads, ⟦29⟧. ⟦30⟧ He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe ⟦E22⟧ helped in ⟦31⟧ such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. ⟦32⟧

rows.quest:98094:title: Scout Support
rows.quest:846:obj:0: ⟦E39⟧ wants you to bring him 6 vials of ⟦E40⟧, 6 bundles of ⟦E41⟧, and 6 samples of ⟦E42⟧.
rows.quest:846:details:0: It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.
rows.quest:846:details:1: I want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.
rows.quest:846:details:2: Collect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
rows.quest:846:progress:0: I see you are back, ⟦40⟧.⟦41⟧⟦42⟧While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.⟦43⟧⟦44⟧The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.⟦45⟧⟦46⟧If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:846:completion:0: I see you are quite industrious, ⟦47⟧.
rows.quest:846:completion:1: No doubt we shall soon have a fitting surprise for those dwarves.
rows.quest:849:obj:0: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to ⟦E39⟧.
rows.quest:849:details:0: Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge

rows.quest:849:details:3: Not only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.
rows.quest:849:details:4: Make me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:849:progress:0: Once the dwarven flying machine has been destroyed I will feel the sweet satisfaction of revenge.
rows.quest:849:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦49⟧! May you be revered in ⟦E33⟧ as a defender of sacred tauren lands and a champion of the lost tribe.
rows.quest:873:details:0: The grand ⟦E47⟧ is lord of these waters. Great is his strength, and solemn his pride. The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.
rows.quest:873:details:1: But I do not fear him. I am grateful he is here. He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.
rows.quest:873:details:2: If you are ready, then swim out and search for ⟦E47⟧, the Deep Doom.
rows.quest:873:details:3: His spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.
rows.quest:873:completion:0: You now are one with ⟦E47⟧, ⟦51⟧. His spirit is with you. He lurks in your eyes...
rows.quest:873:completion:1: Eyes that, one day, will learn to see.
rows.quest:874:details:0: You have hunted the beasts of the ⟦E2⟧. Your spirit is strong. But a hunter must always be prepared. A true hunter can stalk prey down any path. Mountains and swamps will not sway ⟦52⟧.
rows.quest:874:details:2: Find my sister, Mahren. She hunts the great water beasts along the coast. She will be your teacher in their ways.
rows.quest:874:details:3: But be wary in your search for her, for the ⟦E2⟧' coast is held by humans.
rows.quest:874:completion:0: My brother sent you, did he? Then you must have proven yourself to him. If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.
rows.quest:874:completion:1: Are you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?
rows.quest:1153:obj:0: Find an ⟦E49⟧ on a ⟦E50⟧ or Surveyor and bring it to ⟦E12⟧ at Camp Taurajo in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1153:details:0: ⟦53⟧, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

rows.quest:3514:obj:0: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, ⟦E53⟧.
rows.quest:3514:details:0: This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.
rows.quest:3514:details:1: She'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The ⟦E14⟧ will not tolerate her outrunners here.

rows.quest:3514:progress:0: We cannot allow the ⟦E1⟧ on our land, ⟦60⟧. Make this known.
rows.quest:3514:completion:0: You're a tough one! Ridding the Den of Rynthariel is a major step, ⟦61⟧. They will be slow to regroup, and so we can count on less ⟦E1⟧ runners in the ⟦E2⟧. They will think again before sending another this way.
rows.quest:857:obj:0: ⟦E54⟧ wants you to retrieve for him the ⟦E55⟧.
rows.quest:857:details:0: The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!
rows.quest:857:details:1: Those dirty excavators uncovered it... so beautiful it was. Deemed the ⟦E55⟧, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.
rows.quest:857:details:2: It should have been mine! Mine I say!
rows.quest:857:details:3: General Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!
rows.quest:857:details:4: Others wanted it and they had to be stopped! That bastard Twinbraid drove me off.
rows.quest:857:details:5: Now I want it back. Back I say!
rows.quest:857:progress:0: Where is the ⟦E55⟧? I need it now! Need I say!
rows.quest:857:completion:0: At last, the power is mine again! Mine I say!

You have the look of someone who's been outside the walls of ⟦E59⟧ for a while.⟦63⟧⟦64⟧I myself would travel in the name of the Warchief if ⟦E60⟧ didn't have need of my skills here in the city.
